bloques.titulo: je desto: the more the more
texto: It is used to say that two things grow or decrease at the same time: **Je mehr ich arbeite, desto weniger Freizeit habe ich** (the more work, the less free time I have). The first part takes **je** and the verb at the end; the second one starts with **desto** and the verb goes in second position.
With adjectives, the comparative is used: **Je älter man wird, desto ruhiger wird man** (the more one becomes, the more quiet it becomes).

In **je … desto**, **je** introduces the first comparison and equals «How much?»; **desto** introduces the comparison result («more / so much more»). The complete structure usually shows both parts: **Je mehr …, desto besser …**. Do not confuse this **je** with its independent use of «per / each», as in **zehn Euro je Person**.

filas: The more work, the less free time I have
